name: Helichrysum italicum extract
description: Helichrysum italicum extract (CAS 90045-56-0 ), also sourced and listed under Helichrysum angustifolium ext., is a botanical extract derived from the immortelle flower. Assigned FEMA 2592 , it is used across cosmetic, flavor, and nutraceutical applications for its antioxidant activity and distinctive aromatic profile. In fine fragrance and flavor formulations, it contributes warm, honey-like, and slightly herbaceous notes that distinguish premium products in the global market. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into anti-aging serums, facial oils, and skin-repair creams where its antioxidant properties help protect formulations and support stability. In food and beverage applications, it functions as a natural flavoring agent under its FEMA designation, appearing in confectionery, liqueurs, and specialty food products. Nutraceutical and supplement manufacturers also use it as a botanical active in encapsulated or liquid formats targeting oxidative stress positioning for health products. Helichrysum italicum extract is available as an essential oil, CO₂ extract, and standardized liquid or dry extract depending on the specific requirements of the intended application. Technical and cosmetic-grade material is most common, with packaging typically ranging from small amber vials for fragrance sampling to bulk drums for industrial production.
